verdict.rationale: Glama mentions automating workflows with schedules or webhooks (glama-docs-10), but nothing in the evidence describes versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations. The API's /v1 path versioning and deprecation flags concern the directory API, not user automations. Building MCP servers from GitHub concerns server hosting and documents no rollback. Neither transfers to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
